name: Implicit KD-Tree for Iso-Surface Ray Tracing
definition: A memory-efficient acceleration structure for iso-surface ray tracing that uses an implicit balanced binary kd-tree to store min/max values for early subtree culling, avoiding storage of pointers and splitting planes.
summary: The Implicit KD-Tree is a memory-efficient acceleration structure for coherent iso-surface ray tracing that eliminates explicit pointers and split-plane coordinates by using implicit addressing in a balanced binary tree.
